product.title: Aspen's DarkSide Ghost Tour

description.text: Get spooky in Aspen with this guided ghost tour. Timed for nightfall according to season, experience a creepier side of Aspen's historic downtown as you slip through shadowed streets and into the dark haunts of the past. Stops include Wheeler Opera House, Smuggler Mountain. Experience a thrill as you hear about the gruesome history that created these ghosts, and glance around, wondering where the wraiths will emerge from. Ideal for visitors basing in Aspen who want a guided mountain-town experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
